observations.classification: existing ADLER-L11-CAMERA-SEGMENT-ADMISSION and historical CAM-PPS-F005 continuation; no new count
observations.condition: A computed camera segment has nonzero finite components yet its f32 squared length rounds to zero (or computed length becomes nonfinite); whether real admitted scene inputs produce such a delta is unproved.
observations.trace: Current sweep forms endpoint minus origin and maps every Dir3 constructor error to fraction1/no hit without shape cast. Aim substitutes camera direction but preserves the measured muzzle distance; soft occlusion substitutes negative-Z and preserves separately computed subject distance. Bevy new_and_length rejects nonpositive/nonfinite length, with Zero/Infinite/NaN classification based on the completed length. Exact locked glam Vec3 source computes sqrt of componentwise dot. Under ordinary f32 arithmetic a represented nonzero magnitude around 1e-30 has squared magnitude around 1e-60, below f32 minimum subnormal, yielding zero after rounding; this is mathematical reasoning, not a product probe.
observations.qualification: Do not infer ordinary scene reachability, a successful shape cast, actual clearance, enabled features, floating-point environment or visible effects. Prior 059 rows2346–2348 and prior current assessment cover this family; preserve aim and occlusion as separately conditioned subcontracts.
observations.later_repair_direction: After the audit and separately authorized work, choose coherent direction/length/endpoints and explicit zero versus nonzero rejected-query policy while retaining intended camera behavior and separate failure owners.

observations.classification: prior L12 open question narrowed with separately attributed source; no new finding
